To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we provide the first formalization for tamper-proof hardware in the context of universal composable cryptography, (2) we provide the only known UC-secure two party computation protocol that can be realized with tamper-proof hardware, and (3) we provide the most efficient UC-secure noninteractive secure computation protocol.
we provide the first universally composable (non-interactive) protocols for two-party computation and non-interactive secure function evaluation based on tamperproof hardware tokens.

(i) the security of two-party computation protocols based on tampered-proof hardware tokens can be reduced to the security of signature cards and (ii) the functionality of signature cards can be modeled as a simple signature functionality.
